verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents built-in Agentforce agents in Sales Cloud that autonomously handle repetitive sales tasks across the deal cycle, such as qualifying leads, updating opportunities and closing renewals. The evidence describes admin-deployed autonomous agents rather than a documented flow where an individual user hands tasks to an in-product assistant, and all of it is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-app conversational assistant that users delegate ad-hoc tasks to, detail on which Sales Cloud editions include Agentforce, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Deploy AI agents 24/7 to autonomously handle repetitive tasks, expand your pipeline, and boost revenue without adding headcount.
